name: @tci/risk-analyzer
description: Python-based multimodal risk analyzer using Parselmouth and MediaPipe

scripts.dev: source venv/bin/activate && uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port ${RISK_ANALYZER_PORT:-$(grep -m1 '^RISK_ANALYZER_PORT=' ../../.env 2>/dev/null | cut -d= -f2 || echo 3305)}
scripts.setup: python3.10 -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate && pip install --upgrade pip && pip install -r requirements.txt
